tools.name: exchange_search_capabilities
tools.description: Search across sovereign AI services, MCP hubs, physical businesses, Overture GERS places, UCP merchants, marine/harbor sensor oracles, ShoreKey stays, and federated x402 Bazaar endpoints.

tools.name: exchange_get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the complete machine-readable Executable Capability Profile (input/output schemas, exact pricing, ERC-8004 identity, spatial license layer, and live operational reputation) for a profile_id.

tools.name: exchange_evaluate_reputation
tools.description: Evaluate measured operational reliability (successful_execution_rate, p50/p95 latency, verified_transactions, repeat_agent_cohorts, endpoint_availability, and dispute_and_failure_receipts) before spending.

tools.name: exchange_quote_scenario
tools.description: Quote a multi-step physical/digital commerce plan (e.g. harbor state + dining brief + compliance rules + Switchboard translation) against an authorized budget ceiling in cents.

tools.name: exchange_execute_capability
tools.description: Execute a priced capability using a Stripe-funded spend key (sbk_*/sbd_*) and optional Google AP2 mandate budget guard, returning structured output and an execution receipt.

tools.name: exchange_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a detached Ed25519 JWS execution attestation (`atlas.x402.execution_attestation.v1`) against its canonical RFC 8785 JCS payload and public key.

tools.name: exchange_list_business_templates
tools.description: List standardized Agentification-as-a-Service schemas, protocols, payment rails, and safety gates across 10 physical-world business verticals (restaurant, marina, hotel, parking, studio, venue, rental, EV, retail, municipality).
